title: Until Dawn
japaneseTitle: アンティル・ドーン 惨劇の山荘
shortDescription: Supermassive Games' cinematic horror masterpiece tracking eight teenagers trapped on Blackwood Mountain with a ruthless 'Butterfly Effect' branching choice system.
historicalSignificance: Redefined interactive slasher horror by giving every single playable character permanent mortality, pioneering modern cinematic streamable choice-based adventures.

editorialContent.overview: One year after the tragic disappearance of twin sisters, eight friends reunite at a secluded mountain lodge on Blackwood Mountain, only to be stalked by a masked psychopath and ancient cannibalistic Wendigos.
editorialContent.gameplay: Focuses on cinematic camera angles, environmental clue gathering, high-stakes quick-time reactions, and the signature 'Don't Move' mechanic utilizing DualShock 4 motion gyroscopes.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Powered by Guerrilla's Decima Engine (then known as the Killzone Shadow Fall engine), delivering terrifying photorealistic facial animation featuring actors Rami Malek and Hayden Panettiere.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Became a streaming phenomenon on YouTube and Twitch due to viewers reacting to shocking branching permutations and character deaths.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS4 physical disc and remade from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5 for PS5 and PC.

awards: BAFTA Games Award for British Game 2016

technicalSpecs.soundChip: 5.1 Dolby Surround with Jason Graves orchestral horror score
